story.value: The symbol Au comes from the Latin aurum, for Aurora, the goddess of dawn.
Gold was known and highly valued in prehistoric times.

uses.value: Gold alloys are used to make jewelry, decorative items, dental fillings and coins.
Thin sheets of gold, known as gold leaf, are mainly used in arts and crafts for gilding.
Gold can be used to make electrical connectors and printed circuit boards.
Gold is used for coating certain space satellites, as it is a good reflector of infrared and is inert.
